info.title: Ambulancias GoRuiz API
info.description: Minimal OpenAPI surface — health, login, hospitals, ambulances, teams, diensts (scheduling), appointments, documents, payroll, mechanics, and support-access (JIT break-glass). Full reference: docs/API-REFERENCE.md and docs/domains/

get.description: Returns server and MongoDB connection status. No authentication.

post.description: Authenticates with email and password. Rate limited (5 attempts / 15 min per IP). Superadmin may require MFA when SUPERADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED is enabled.

403.description: Account or company inactive, MFA not enrolled

get.description: Requires module `hospitals`. Admin and worker roles.

post.description: Admin only. Body validated with Zod (trim, non-empty strings).

patch.description: Same schema and handler as PUT; only sent fields are updated.

delete.description: Returns 409 if referenced in trips or workday-summary toAddress (exact name/address match).

get.description: Requires module `ambulances`. Admin, worker, and other roles with company context.

post.description: Admin or jefe_mecanicos. Body validated with Zod (strict). `companyId` is derived from JWT, not from body.

delete.description: Admin or jefe_mecanicos. Returns 409 with `sources` if referenced in dienst assignments, teams, workday-summary, mechanics work orders/issues, or trip-setup.

get.description: Requires module `teams`. Admin only. Scoped by JWT companyId.

post.description: Admin only. Driver must have ambulanceRole driver|both; medic medic|both. `companyId` from JWT.

409.description: Duplicate pair or member already in another team

get.description: Returns team IDs whose driver+medic pair appears in Dienst assignments for the given weekStartDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Requires module `teams`.

patch.description: Admin only. Uses PATCH (not PUT). Full body with driver, medic, rotationMode, optional fixedDienstNumber and ambulanceId.

delete.description: Admin only. Returns 409 with `sources` if referenced by Dienst.weekTeamId (`dienst-week-team`).

post.description: Admin only. Requires modules `scheduling` and `teams`. Idempotent guard: returns 400 if Diensts already exist for the week. Body: `{ weekStartDate: YYYY-MM-DD }`.

400.description: Validation, duplicate week, or no templates

post.description: Admin only. Requires module `scheduling`. Returns 409 with `sources` and `counts` if trips, trip-setup, workday-summary, or mechanics-issues reference assignment slots in that week.

post.summary: Assign team to all days of a Dienst week
post.description: Admin only. Requires modules `scheduling` and `teams`.

post.summary: Assign one user (driver/medic) to a Dienst week
post.description: Admin only. Requires module `scheduling`.

post.summary: Assign ambulance to all days of a Dienst week
post.description: Admin only. Requires modules `scheduling` and `ambulances`.

post.summary: Clear driver/medic/ambulance for a Dienst week
post.description: Admin only. Requires module `scheduling`. Clears people on one dienstNumber for the week; keeps slot structure.

get.description: Admin only. Requires module `scheduling`. Scoped by JWT companyId.

post.description: Admin only. Requires module `scheduling`. Unique per companyId + dienstNumber.
Requires module `appointments`. Creates a request with status `pending`. Worker only.

get.description: Returns all appointments for the authenticated worker. Requires module `appointments`.
Admin only. Status `pending`, scoped by JWT companyId (legacy null companyId resolved via worker).
Admin only. Status in `pending`, `proposed`, `cancellation_requested`. Scoped by companyId.
Admin only. Query `status` defaults to `pending`. Valid statuses: pending, proposed, confirmed, cancelled, rescheduled, cancellation_requested.
Admin only. Returns confirmed/rescheduled appointments whose selectedSlot.start falls within `from`–`to` (ISO). Both query params required.

patch.description: Admin only. PATCH (not PUT). Optional fields: reason, details, selectedSlot. Providing selectedSlot sets status to `rescheduled`. At least one field required. Scoped by companyId.

delete.description: Admin only. Sets status to `cancelled`. Scoped by companyId.

post.description: Admin only. 1–3 future slots, ordered ascending by start. Sets status to `proposed`. From `pending` or `proposed`.
Worker only. selectedSlot must match one of proposedSlots. Sets status to `confirmed`.
Worker only. From `proposed` back to `pending` (clears proposedSlots).
Worker only. Sets status to `cancellation_requested` with a message (max 1000 chars).
Admin only. From `cancellation_requested` to `cancelled`. Scoped by companyId.

delete.description: Worker only. Allowed only when status is already `cancelled`.

get.description: Requires module `documents`. Returns non-deleted documents with delivery ack/read aggregates. Soft-deleted rows are excluded.

post.description: Requires module `documents`. PDF only (max 10 MB). Optional `targetWorkerId` limits distribution to one active worker; omit to distribute to all active workers. Optional `requiresAcknowledgment` (single file). Files are deleted from disk if validation or DB/distribution fails. Rate limit: 10 uploads / 5 min / IP.

400.description: Validation error (PDF-only, invalid target, MIME mismatch)

post.description: Requires module `documents`. PDF only, up to 50 files. Auto-distributes to all active workers on upload. `requiresAcknowledgment` only when exactly one file. Orphan files cleaned up on failure.

delete.description: Sets `deletedAt`; file remains on disk but `GET /api/files/:filename` denies access. Deliveries are retained for audit.

get.description: Requires module `documents`. Returns deliveries for non-deleted documents only.

post.description: Requires prior read (`readAt`). Password re-auth. Informational docs (`requiresAcknowledgment: false`) return 400. Idempotent if already acknowledged.

400.description: Missing password or doc does not require ack

post.description: Requires module `payroll`. PDF only (max 10 MB, `uploadPdfOnly`). With `workerId` → manual assignment; without → conservative filename auto-match by employeeNumber. Replaces prior active payroll for same worker+period (soft-invalidates). Orphan files cleaned on validation/DB/replacement failure. Stored filename sanitized for GET /api/files/:filename.

403.description: Worker not in company or module disabled

post.description: Requires module `payroll`. Up to 20 PDFs (field `payrolls`). Auto-match per file. Partial success allowed; failed files cleaned up.

get.description: Active documents only (`deletedAt: null`). Scoped by admin companyId.
Requires module `payroll`. Roles: worker, mecanico, jefe_mecanicos, jefe_logistica. Filtered by workerId and companyId when JWT includes companyId.

patch.description: Sets deletedAt; file retained on disk but GET /api/files denies access.

post.description: Requires module `workday`. Driver/medic in body are ignored; assignment in DB is source of truth. Returns 409 if a final closure exists for assignment+date. Validates kmEnd >= kmStart for non-cancelled trips.

get.description: Requires module `workday`. Returns trips with `sentInSummary: false` scoped by companyId. Workers see only trips where they are driver or medic.
Requires module `workday`. Tenant-scoped by assignment resolution and `companyId` on TripSetup document.

put.description: Requires module `workday`. Filter `{ assignmentId, companyId }` after tenant assignment resolution.

post.description: Requires module `workday`. Trip payloads in body are not trusted: only trip `_id` values are used to reload open trips from DB (`sentInSummary: false`, same assignment and companyId). Totals and effective patients are computed server-side. One final closure per assignment+date (409 on duplicate). Validates finalKm >= initialKm.

409.description: Duplicate final closure or stale client trip snapshot

get.description: Requires module `workday`. Scoped by companyId. Workers see only summaries where they are driver or medic.

post.description: Requires module `workday`. Same trip reload rules as final closure. Rejected with 409 if a final closure already exists for assignment+date. Multiple partial closures allowed before final.

409.description: Final closure already exists or stale snapshot

get.description: Admin only. Requires module `workday`. Query `status` defaults to `pending` (uses `isReviewed: false` among other legacy fields).

patch.description: Requires module `workday` and admin role. Sets `isReviewed: true` and `reviewedAt`. Strict companyId match (no legacy null fallback). Downstream Praemien manual-daily requires final closures with `isFinalClosure: true`.

post.description: Requires module `mechanics`. Rate limit 10/min per IP. Accepts JSON or `multipart/form-data` with field `photos` (max 5, JPG/PNG/WEBP only). Images are stored under public `/uploads/` (images-only policy). Uploaded files are deleted if validation fails after Multer. New issues always get `companyId` from the dienst assignment (server-derived).

403.description: Forbidden, module disabled, or ambulance/tenant mismatch

get.description: Admin, jefe_mecanicos, or mecanico. Scoped by JWT companyId. Legacy issues without companyId are excluded.
Query `status`: `open` (default), `seen`, or `closed`. Scoped by companyId.

patch.description: Tenant-scoped update `{ _id, companyId }`. Legacy issues without companyId return 403.

delete.description: Admin or jefe_mecanicos. Tenant-scoped delete; removes attachment images from disk.

get.description: Optional filter `ambulanceId` (24-char ObjectId). Invalid ambulanceId returns 400.

post.description: Admin or jefe_mecanicos. `assignedTo` must be `mecanico` or `jefe_mecanicos` in the same company. Lifecycle: pending → in_progress → completed | cancelled.

patch.description: Admin/jefe_mecanicos: full patch. Mecanico: status in_progress or completed with completionNotes.

post.description: Break-glass operational window only. Does NOT grant tenant impersonation or admin-route override. Rate limit: 12 requests / 15 min per IP. Requester cannot self-approve.

get.description: Triggers expiration sweep for stale approved records before listing.

post.description: Approve requires step-up MFA (`x-step-up-token` or `x-step-up-code`) and a reviewer distinct from requester. Deny does not require step-up. Rate limit: 20 reviews / 15 min per IP.
Requires step-up MFA. Rate limit: 10 revocations / 15 min per IP.

get.summary: Check active support access for actor and tenant (superadmin)
get.description: Audited active-check. Triggers expiration sweep. Does not grant API impersonation.
Audited read. UI: SuperadminSecurityMonitoringPage.

AppointmentStatus.description: Workflow: pending → proposed → confirmed | rescheduled; cancellation_requested → cancelled; admin/worker cancel paths also set cancelled.

proposedSlots.description: Future slots ordered ascending by start; each start < end.

companyId.description: Required on new records; legacy may be null

assignedTo.description: User id; role must be mecanico or jefe_mecanicos

WorkdaySummaryTripRef.description: Client sends trip `_id` references; embedded fields are not trusted for totals.
